'''Liddy Ravora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She was a waitress at [[Bell's Cantina]] prior to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], but left to become an [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]]. After amassing [[Currency/Legends|money]], Ravora returned and purchased the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], where she ran it for over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]].

==Biography==
Prior to [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was seventeen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old when the partial destruction of the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]] took place. Since [[Gender/Legends|he]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], according to {{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}, the destruction took place in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' states that the destruction happened four years prior, so the book's perspective is in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The book states that she purchased the Cantina over a decade ago. Therefore, she must have worked there prior to [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]].</ref> Ravora was a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] at [[Bell's Cantina]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and veteran [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]' hangout on the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]]. The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], and orbited [[Gus Treta/Legends|Gus Treta]], one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. However, Ravora realized the value of information, and left her job to become an amateur [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]]. Ravora began trading secrets and eventually amassed a small [[Currency/Legends|fortune]]. With her newfound wealth, Ravora returned and purchased Bell's Cantina, where she remained the owner for over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]]. Ravora gained the trust of the spacers that frequented the establishment, and worked for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Gormo Vosadii Grasso]], who owned the station, and ran it as a legitimate business.<ref name="SoF" />

==Personality and traits==
Liddy Ravora was able to gain the trust of many spacers, and was know to help them find work when unemployed. Her first loyalties lied with her highest paying customer, who was generally Gormo the Hutt. She was known to be particularly charming and cunning, and knew the value information could have.<ref name="SoF" />

==Skills and abilities==
Ravora was trained in deception and negotiation, and was particularly skilled in perception and surveillance. Despite this, she had relatively average agility, strength, and intellect, and had no extremely outstanding talents or abilities.<ref name="SoF" />

==Equipment==
Ravora carried a short range [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]. She also owned an encrypted [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="SoF" />
